name: Will there be visible seams on my new stone kitchen countertops?

mainEntity.name: Will there be visible seams on my new stone kitchen countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visible seams are a standard part of installing stone countertops, but skilled fabricators place them strategically to keep them discreet. Seam locations depend on slab sizes, kitchen layout, cooktop cutouts, and weight distribution. Installers use color-matched epoxy adhesives and seam-pulling tools to create tight, level joints. While seams cannot be entirely invisible on patterned stone, proper placement avoids high-traffic focal points.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most large kitchens require seams. Fabricators place them in low-visibility spots and join them with color-matched epoxy to keep lines tight and discreet.
